description: One epoch of the circle: its phase and deadlines from the contract (get_epoch), and from the read API the summary, the metrics (cleared ratio: the share of debt that netting removed, so only the net cash moves) and the settlements, i.e. who owes whom what in cash. Use it after an epoch closed; use x207_simulate_clearing to test a proposal before it is submitted. Returns {epoch, contract, summary, metrics, settlements, source, warnings}. An epoch that does not exist is an error; if the read API is down the contract record is still returned, with the failures in `warnings`.

epoch.description: Epoch number, 0 or more. Leave out for the current epoch, which is still open and has no settlements yet.

settlements_limit.description: How many settlement rows to return, 1 to 200 (default 20). A busy epoch has more; raise it to see them all.

name: x207_epoch_report
title: Epoch report (report 207)
